Title: La Dompteuse Encagée
Description: Crafted by the renowned niche fragrance brand, Serge Lutens, La Dompteuse Encagee is a harmonious blend of key notes that includes the exotic frangipani, the rich and creamy ylang-ylang, and the subtly sweet almond. Each note has been carefully selected to create a scent that is both captivating and sophisticated, ideal for any occasion.

Title: Hacienderos
Description: This scent beautifully balances clean and dirty notes, reflecting the duality of a typical day on the farm. A testament to the beauty and simplicity of rural life, capturing the essence of a day spent in the fields.

Title: OMNiA AMETHYST3 Inspired Perfume
Description: A floral fragrance, with woody and musky notes in the background.

Title: Jolie Fleur
Description: Jolie Fleur Verte captures the crisp green color and dewy aroma of lily of the valley in Tory Burch's garden. A tomboy and easygoing mix -- hints of mandarin, neroli oil and jasmine open up into soft scents of lily of the valley. All in a beautiful glass bottle with a fretwork top and green accents.

Title: Chance Eau Tendre
Description: An exquisite blend of delectable Quince and Grapefruit notes, Hyacinth and Jasmine accents, and a warm, sensuous blend of Musk, Iris, Virginia Cedar and Amber creates a truly magical aroma. It's the perfect blend of sweetness and mystery, letting you express your unique and tender personality.

Title: F8 Floral Mist
Description: Aficionado F8 is a fruity, aromatic, and floral fragrance that contains notes of purple passion fruit, Shangri-la peony, and vanilla orchid. For true, always sexy 'bombshells' – the women with an attitude that requires attention.

Title: J'adore
Description: J'adore Eau de Parfum is a floral perfume arrangement featuring an accord of solar ylang-ylang and Damascus rose, combined with a rare duo of jasmine grandiflorum and jasmine sambac.

Title: Light Blue
Description: The sensuality of sun-kissed skin, the invigorating breeze of the Mediterranean, and the fruity and floral scents from lush vegetation: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue captures the lightness of a day cradled by the sound of waves caressing the cliffs of Capri.

Title: F24 Fresh Blossom
Description: F24, our version of Burberry Her embodies effortless beauty with its vibrant mix of fruity and floral notes, complemented by a soft, delicate base. This fragrance is designed for the woman who brightens every room she enters.

Title: Chance Eau Tendre Body Mist
Description: Chance Eau Tendre by Chanel is a captivating floral-fruity fragrance for women. It blends the sweet notes of quince and grapefruit with hyacinth and jasmine, while a warm base of musk, iris, Virginia cedar, and amber adds depth. This enchanting scent balances sweetness and mystery, letting your unique and tender personality shine with confidence.

Title: Bombshell
Description: Confidence and glamour—Bombshell attitude in a light-as-air mist. Our signature, award-winning Bombshell fragrance is a timeless mix of fresh-cut, exotic flowers and afternoon sun.

Title: Body Mist
Description: It leaves the skin pleasantly scented, experiencing the feeling of floating in a sweet cloud of icing sugar.

Title: Mandarino di Amalfi
Description: Mandarino di Amalfi by Tom Ford is a citrus aromatic fragrance for both women and men. It opens with top notes of lemon, grapefruit, mint, basil, tarragon, and black currant, followed by a heart of orange blossom, jasmine, clary sage, shiso, coriander, and black pepper. The base features musk, vetiver, amber, labdanum, and civet, creating a vibrant and complex scent.

Title: Eau Parfumée au Thé Vert
Description: A delicate, captivating fragrance that offers deep relaxation during your private, luxurious moments. Belonging to the aromatic citrus family, it brings a sense of tranquility and elegance.

Title: Fruit Fantasy
Description: Young’s Spray Cologne are low alcohol contents perfect for the whole family/unisex cologne.

Title: Neroli Portofino
Description: Transportive and invigorating, Neroli Portofino captures the cool breezes, sparkling waters and lush foliage of the Italian Riviera. This reinvention of a classic eau de cologne features crisp citrus oils, surprising floral notes and amber undertones to leave a splashy yet substantive impression.

Title: Eau de Parfum
Description: Just like all Chloe's bold, arty and free-spirited designs, the fragrance is Women in a rather non-traditional, not all-out-girly way. Its accords expertly play against each other and they seduce the audience by being both elegant and daring at the same time.

Title: Praddox Inspired Perfume
Description: Smells like a vibrant bouquet of fresh jasmine and citrus neroli, blended with the creamy warmth of amber and sweet vanilla.

Title: Lime Basil & Mandarin
Description: One of our signature fragrance, a peppery basil and aromatic white thyme brings an unexpected twist to the scent of limes on a Caribbean breeze, which is a modern classic.

Title: Avon Scent Essence Sparkly Citrus
Description: Sparkly Citrus by Avon is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women.

Title: Oh Sugar Pink
Description: This fragrance opens with notes of Orange, Passionfruit, and Melon, followed by notes of Muguet, Rose, and Jasmine, all on a base of Musk, Vanilla, and Caramel.

Title: Eau de Mandarine Ambrée
Description: A vibrant cologne housed in the iconic lantern bottle. Inspired by the sunlit vibrance of an orchard, this fragrance is a lively and shimmering composition that brings effortless joy to any moment.

Title: White Citrus
Description: Inspired by the sun-drenched citrus groves of the Mediterranean coast, White Citrus is an invigorating blend of crisp citrus and water lily.

Title: Citrus Charm
Description: Engage with the charm of citrus, a heart note of a white floral and a base note of fruity scent came from apple.

Title: Virgin Island Water
Description: Virgin Island Water was inspired by a sailing trip near Ginger Island in the Caribbean. It opens with a citrusy cocktail of white bergamot, Jamaican lime, Sicilian mandarin. The citruses are accompanied by a note of copra, the white inner flesh of the coconut. The heart includes intensive Indian jasmine and sweet hibiscus, exotic ylang-ylang and cold, spicy ginger. The base of the composition includes sugar cane, musk and white rum.

Title: Plum Perfume Oil
Description: Burqooq Plum Perfume Oil features a sweet, fruity, and juicy plum aroma with a refreshing, slightly tart quality. Its moderate intensity makes it noticeable yet not overpowering, offering a deliciously inviting scent that adds sweetness and vibrancy.

Title: Sweet Honesty
Description: A fragrance that reminds you of the sweet and innocent feeling of your first love. Citrus clean Aldehydes and Innocent Vanilla define this Women, carefree scent. The fragrance opens with sparkling and delightful Aldehydes. In the floral heart lies spicy pink carnation, delicate rose and sophisticated ylang ylang. The scent closes with the velvety softness of Heliotrope.

Title: Mon Paris
Description: Mon Paris is a vibrant and intense fragrance symbolizing modern love. It opens with juicy notes of bergamot, strawberry, raspberry, and pear, followed by a floral heart of datura, peony, jasmine, and orange blossom. The scent settles into a sensual base of white musk, ambroxan, and rich patchouli.

Title: Flowerbomb
Description: The dreams expressed by the contrast of the bergamot citrus with the sweetness of osmanthus in an explosion of petals with jasmine, orange blossom, freesia and orchid. Based with musk and patchouli adds an intense sensuality and seduction.

Title: Far Away
Description: Far Away Classic by Avon is an Amber Floral fragrance for women. Top notes are Coconut, Ylang-Ylang, Peach, Karo Karounde and Orange; middle notes are Jasmine, Gardenia, Violet, Freesia, Osmanthus and Rose; base notes are Vanilla, Sandalwood, Amber and Musk.

Title: Chance Eau Tendre
Description: Chance Eau Tendre by Chanel is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Top notes are Quince and Grapefruit; middle notes are Hyacinth and Jasmine; base notes are Musk, Iris, Virginia Cedar and Amber.

Title: Flora Eau de Toilette
Description: Perfume Flora by Gucci opens the door to new creations by the house of Gucci, which are being planned for a younger audience. Top notes introduce citruses and peony, a heart is enriched with rose and osmanthus (Chinese flower which enchants with fruity-floral aromas with leather notes), while base notes encompass patchouli and sandalwood.

Title: Life Colour
Description: A spirited combination of Lemon, Leaf, and Peach head this alluring fragrance of Melon, Cyclamen, and Aquatic at its core, harmonized by resounding notes of Ambery, Vanilla, and Musk.

Title: Orange Blossom
Description: Orange Blossom is a fragrance inspired by the romantic atmosphere of colonial Spain at the Bel Air hotel in Los Angeles. It opens with fresh notes of cedrat, green leaves, and clementine. The heart reveals a delicate floral blend of orange blossom and water lily, while the base features the soft aromas of orange blossom and lilac.

Title: White Musk Flora
Description: Spritz our White Musk Flora Fragrance Mist for a fresh, empowering and daring twist on our sensual, iconic cruelty-free musk. Uplifting notes of bright bergamot, graceful muguet and comforting musk combine for a modern bouquet that’s 100% vegan.

Title: White Musk
Description: Enjoy a beautiful fresh bouquet of bright white florals combined with soft sensual woods and clean white musks.

Title: FIEVRE ROUGE
Description: Le Leopard Sacré is a bold, floral-oriental fragrance with a fruity and floral bouquet. It opens with peach and red fruits, followed by jasmine and ginger in the heart. The base features a rich blend of Peruvian balsam, vanilla, and oud, with warm amber and spices enhancing the composition.

Title: Fleur Musc
Description: Narciso Rodriguez Fleur Musc for Her by Narciso Rodriguez is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Top note is Pink Pepper; middle notes are Rose, Musk and Peony; base notes are Patchouli, Violet and Amber.

Title: PEONY BLUSH&SUED3 JM Inspired Perfume
Description: An exquisite floral with delicate rose and honey accents and a subtle, green freshness. Fills the fragrance with the scent of peonies, just as they unfold.

Title: Daisy Dream
Description: Daisy Dream is a refined and airy version of the original fragrance, featuring a unique blend of floral and fruity notes, including blackberry, pear, blue wisteria, jasmine, and coconut water. Created by perfumer Alberto Morillas with Ann Gottlieb and Marc Jacobs, it evokes a light, blue effect sensation.

Title: Viva La Juicy
Description: The perfume Viva la Juicy was presented as a gourmet floral fragrance, which opens with notes of wild berries and juicy mandarin. The heart encompasses a floral blend of honeysuckle, gardenia, and jasmine, while the base notes await us with a gourmet rhapsody of amber, caramel, vanilla, sandalwood, and pralines.

Title: Good GirlNight
Description: An alluring and daring scent that combines the sweetness of creamy florals with bold tonka beans. Playful, confident, and sensual.

Title: Miss Dior
Description: The new Miss Dior Eau de Parfum is a colorful floral bouquet, like a “millefiori” alive with notes of Grasse rose, peony, iris, and lily of the valley.

Title: Peony & Blush Suede
Description: Peony & Blush Suede by Jo Malone London is a Floral fragrance for women. Top note is Red Apple; middle notes are Peony, Rose, Carnation and Jasmine; base note is Suede. It's an exquisite blend that creates a memorable and lasting impact– a beauty that truly stands the test of time.

Title: Rich Amber
Description: Enjoy a Fruity, Floral, and Musky Scent. Mixed with Saffron, Ginger, Bergamot, and Mandarin Orange.

Title: Lavender & Musk
Description: Brightened by the radiant freshness of citrus fruits, the Lavender Eau de Cologne has a light, breezy scent, underlined by a woody, musky base with a captivating trail. This vibrant Cologne is a celebration of summer that captures the sunshine and brightness of Haute-Provence.

Title: Jasmine Noir
Description: Jasmin Noir by Bvlgari is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Top notes are Gardenia and Green Notes; middle notes are Jasmine Sambac and Almond; base notes are Tonka Bean, Licorice, Precious Woods, Amber, Musk and Patchouli.

Title: Juicy Tropics Floral Punch
Description: The Floral Punch variant is a graceful and Women scent that unfolds with the sweet and ethereal aroma of cherry blossoms in full bloom. This fragrance is designed to evoke the beauty and tranquility of a garden in the height of summer, making it an ideal choice for those who appreciate floral and sophisticated scents.

Title: Wood Sage & Sea Salt
Description: Wood Sage & Sea Salt by Jo Malone London is an Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Create an unforgettable atmosphere with the captivating blend of wood, sage, and sea salt. Experience a surge of energy and renewal with each spritz that lasts throughout the day.
ImagePath: /Wood Sage & Sea Salt – Jo Malone London.png

Title: Patchouli Absolu
Description: Patchouli Absolu by Tom Ford is a rich and intense woody fragrance, offering an elegant blend of earthy patchouli notes with a luxurious, sophisticated depth. Ideal for those who appreciate bold, refined scents, this fragrance exudes warmth and allure with its deep, resinous qualities, making it a versatile choice for both day and night wear.

Title: CHANEL NO.5 Inspired Perfume
Description: A floral bouquet composed around may rose and jasmine, features bright citrus top notes. Aldehydes create a unique presence, while the smooth touch of bourbon vanilla yields an incredibly sensual sillage.

Title: Wood Mystique
Description: Enter a world of opulence and richness beyond compare. Honoring techniques and ingredients indigenous to the Middle East, Estée Lauder Wood Mystique is an ideal blend of ancient hand-crafted luxury and modern good taste. This luxurious, richly woody creation is a unisex fragrance with treasured Rose blooming at its heart.

Title: Eau de Neroli
Description: Eau de Néroli Doré by Hermès is a fragrance for women and men. Top note is Bitter Orange; middle note is Neroli; base note is Saffron.

Title: Santal Woody
Description: A smoky blend of sandalwood, cedar, and slightly powdery leather. It suits best for those who appreciate bold, distinctive woody scents.

Title: OUD WOOD
Description: Oud Wood by Tom Ford is an Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. An exquisite aroma for any occasion, Oud Wood is a timeless scent – perfect for bringing a luxurious and mysterious feel to any ensemble.

Title: EBONY WOOD
Description: A Woody Scents fragrance with notes of grapefruit, cypress, and pink peppercorn, that melts into a coffee heart. Its base of patchouli and vetiver provides a warm and elegant touch.

Title: SELF LOVE
Description: This scent is a Woody Fruity delight of Pink pepper, Kiwi and Rhubarb lavished by hints of Jasmine, Cyclamen and Watermelon, wrapped in a base of Musk, Sandalwood and Lemon tree.

Title: OUD & BERGAMOT BODY MIST
Description: Jo Malone Cologne Intense Collection is inspired by the fragrant tradition of the Middle East. Oud & Bergamot is a fresh interpretation of oud, made from orange, bergamot, lemon, cedar and oud.
ImagePath: /Oud & Bergamot Body Mist – Jo Malone London.png

Title: WILD JASMINE BODY MIST
Description: Let your fearlessly adventurous spirit feel liberated with a few spritzes of our Wild Jasmine Body Mist, part of the Choice Fragrance Collection.
ImagePath: /Wild Jasmine Body Mist – The Body Shop.png

Title: SIGNATURE COLLECTION LAVENDER & SANDALWOOD
Description: Breathe in the fresh scent of evergreens in a meadow breeze with notes of juniper leaves & dewy musk. Lavishly splash or lightly spritz your favorite fragrance, either way you'll fall in love at first mist.

Title: COCO MADEMOISELLE
Description: Coco Mademoiselle by Chanel is an Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Top notes are Orange, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot and Orange Blossom; middle notes are Turkish Rose, Jasmine, Mimosa and Ylang-Ylang; base notes are Patchouli, White Musk, Vanilla, Vetiver, Tonka Bean and Opoponax.

Title: SÌ PASSIONE
Description: Sì Passione by Giorgio Armani is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Top notes are Pear, Black Currant, Pink Pepper and Grapefruit; middle notes are Pineapple, Rose, Jasmine and Heliotrope; base notes are Vanilla, Cedar, Patchouli and Amberwood.

Title: IN LOVE
Description: An exceptional daytime fragrance suitable for every season. Save it for a date, or splash it on every day for that extra something.

Title: MISS DIOR BLOOMING BOUQUET
Description: Experience the caress of a fresh rose dressed in peony flowers. This vivacious eau de toilette reveals a tender heart of peony and Damascus rose. The perfume’s lingering finish is edged with white musk. A floral springtime signature, perfect for a flirty and irresistibly charming Miss Dior.

Title: PEONY & BLUSH SUEDE
Description: The essence of charm. Peonies in voluptuous bloom, exquisitely fragile. Flirtatious with the juicy bite of red apple and the opulence of jasmine, rose and gillyflower. Mingling with the sensuality of soft, blush suede. Luxurious and seductive.

Title: ENGLISH FREESIA
Description: Sophisticated and elegant scent, juicy pears and clean white freesia, blended by a gentle, earthy base that adds depth and warmth.

Title: MIU MIU
Description: Miu Miu by Miu Miu is a Floral fragrance for women. Top notes are Lily-of-the-Valley, Bergamot and Lemon; middle notes are Green Notes, Rose, Jasmine, Black Currant and Peach; base notes are Akigalawood and White Musk.
ImagePath: ../Miu Miu Eau de Parfum – Miu Miu.png

Title: BVLGARI OMNIA PINK SAPPHIRE
Description: Omnia Pink Sapphire is announced as a festive floral Eau de Toilette that captures the essence of the frangipani, sparkling pink pomelo and vanilla musk. The vibrant scent is a daring reminder to run, jump and dance into every day with sweetness and spontaneity. Alberto Morillas composed Pink Sapphire as a whimsical combination of bright citrus and exotic florals.

Title: PINK RUSH
Description: Feel flirty, feminine and fresh with Green, Lemon, Pear, Cassis, and Bergamot fresh top notes open this fragrance. Pineapple, Lily of the Valley, Jasmine, Magnolia, and Freesia provide a perfectly blended balance. Musk, Amber, Cedarwood, Peach, and Moss notes leave an unforgettable lasting impression.

Title: CITRONELLE & GERANIUM
Description: Citronnelle & Geranium by Diptyque is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Lemongrass, Lemon and Eucalyptus; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Neroli and Geranium; base note is White Musk.

Title: BAHAMAS PASSIONFRUIT & BANANA FLOWER
Description: Smells like a fruity island getaway, with the fragrance notes– passionfruit, pineapple leaves and banana flower.
ImagePath: ../Bahamas Passionfruit & Banana Flower – Bath & Body Works.png

Title: NEON RUSH CITRUS FLORAL MUSK
Description: Party fresh all day and all night! A spirited combination of Seaside Citrus has this alluring fragrance of Summer Fig and Jasmine Water at its core, harmonized by resounding notes of DriftWood, Amber, and Musk.

Title: Vanille Diorama
Description: Vanilla Diorama by Dior is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Orange, Pink Pepper and Lemon; middle notes are Rum, Cacao and Cardamom; base notes are Bourbon Vanilla, Sandalwood and Patchouli.

Title: Prada Candy
Description: Prada Candy by Prada is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. The composition includes an elegant mix of musks in the top, a sensual balsamic vanillic accord of benzoin in the heart and sweet modern caramel in the base of the fragrance. Top note is Caramel; middle notes are Powdery Notes and Musk; base notes are Benzoin and Vanilla.

Title: BLACK OPIUM-Illicit Green
Description: A floral fruity gourmand scent for women.

Title: Tom Ford Black Orchid
Description: A luxe and extraordinary fragrance of rich, dark accords merged with a sensual composition of black orchids and spice, the black orchid is both modern and timeless – an homage to worldly glamour and iconic style. Black Orchid is packaged in a fluted, black-glass flacon with ribbed detailing, reflecting a streamlined interpretation of the 1920s and 1930s architecture.

Title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her
Description: Narciso Rodriguez for Her Eau de Parfum by Narciso Rodriguez is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Top notes are Rose and Peach; middle notes are Musk and Amber; base notes are Patchouli and Sandalwood.

Title: Juicy Cologne Sweet Delight
Description: Indulge in a fun, youthful, and irresistibly sweet scent with Juicy Cologne Sweet Delights! Designed for those who love feeling fresh, confident, and carefree, this fragrance delivers a delightful burst of sweetness that lasts all day. Whether you're heading to school, work, or just enjoying a casual day out, let this charming scent elevate your mood and leave a lasting impression!

Title: Le Jardin d'Orange Verte
Description: A fragrance that blends bright citrus notes of orange, lemon, and mandarin with cool mint and green accords for a crisp, natural feel. Earthy oakmoss and patchouli add depth, creating a clean, timeless scent reminiscent of a dewy garden.

Title: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb
Description: The dreams expressed by the contrast of the bergamot citrus with the sweetness of osmanthus in an explosion of petals with jasmine, orange blossom, freesia and orchid. Based with musk and patchouli adds an intense sensuality and seduction. It is explosive as a hand grenade, sweet as dreams!

Title: Vanilla Skies
Description: Apply this before a date to elevate your seductive charm. It highlights notes such as Orange, Grapefruit, Clementine, Mango.

Title: Creed Virgin Island Water
Description: Captures tropical splendor of Ginger Island, Caribbean. Exotic, citrusy cocktail fragrance with main notes bergamot,copra,and spicy ginger.

Title: Love Spell
Description: Love Spell is a fragrance from the Victoria's Secret Secret Garden collection. A lavishly lush combination of peach, cherry blossom and white jasmine make it perfect for your enjoyment.

Title: Vanilla Milkshake
Description: Keep it relaxed and smooth with this lasting fresh scent, inspired by a creamy blend of fluffy vanilla on a base of soft cocoa and sandalwood.

Title: Amouage Interlude Woman
Description: Interlude Woman by Amouage is a complex Chypre Floral fragrance that balances rich contrasts. It opens with vibrant marigold, ginger, grapefruit, and bergamot, leading into an intricate heart of incense, walnut, immortelle, kiwi, honey, opoponax, coffee, sandalwood, rose, orange blossom, and jasmine. The base grounds the scent with deep leather, benzoin, oud, amber, sandalwood, tonka bean, oakmoss, vanilla, and musk, creating a luxurious and captivating trail.

Title: Kilian Black Phantom
Description: Black Phantom by By Kilian is an indulgent Oriental Vanilla fragrance for both women and men. It opens with the bold warmth of rum, giving way to rich layers of dark chocolate, coffee, almond, and heliotrope. The base reveals a decadent blend of caramel, sugar cane, sandalwood, vanilla, tonka, and vetiver, creating a seductive and captivating scent that lingers.

Title: POISON GiRL Inspired Perfume
Description: An amber vanilla fragrance for women.

Title: Guerlain Shalimar
Description: Shalimar Eau de Parfum by Guerlain is an alluring Oriental Spicy fragrance that captivates with its rich complexity. The scent opens with a burst of citruses, bergamot, lemon, cedar, and mandarin orange, leading to a heart of iris, patchouli, vetiver, jasmine, and rose. The base unfolds into a deep, sensual blend of vanilla, incense, leather, opoponax, civet, sandalwood, tonka bean, and musk, creating an unforgettable and timeless allure.

Title: Prada Amber Intense
Description: Oriental Pour Homme Intense amplifies the sophisticated masculinity of the original fragrance, infusing it with the rich, intense aroma of amber and premium ingredients. It perfectly balances tradition with modern trends, staying true to Prada’s signature style.

Title: Don’t Wanna Be Shy
Description: Sweet, playful, and romantic, this fragrance is often described as a luxurious, floral-infused marshmallow. If you adore warm, sugary florals with a sensual and flirtatious edge, this is the perfect scent for you.

Title: Diptyque Eau Duelle
Description: Eau Duelle is a tribute to travel and the timeless allure of vanilla. Along the spice route, vanilla unfolds with luminous, addictive hints of calamus and deep, smoky touches of cypriol. Journeying across time and borders, Madagascar’s Bourbon vanilla reveals a captivating dance between light and shadow.

Title: L'Instant de Guerlain
Description: L'Instant de Guerlain is a luminous Oriental Floral fragrance that captures the essence of elegance and femininity. It opens with a bright burst of mandarin orange, red apple, and bergamot, unfolding into a heart of magnolia, iris, ylang-ylang, and jasmine. As it lingers, a warm, sensual base of white honey, vanilla, amber, benzoin, and musk creates an unforgettable trail of soft, radiant beauty.

Title: Secret Desire
Description: Secret Desire is a warm, spicy fragrance that exudes both allure and sophistication. Designed to captivate at first scent, it inspires boldness, empowering you to take risks and overcome your fears.

Title: Oud & Bergamot
Description: Sparkling bergamot opens the fragrance with a burst of citrus freshness, leading into a dry, intensely woody heart of cedarwood. In the base, rich and resinous oud blends with the textured sweetness of praline, creating a deep, bold trail full of intensity and warmth.
ImagePath: ../Jo Malone London Oud & Bergamot – Jo Malone London.png

Title: Rose Jam Body Spray
Description: A true delight for the senses! Bask in a stunning bouquet of exquisite rose oil, brightened with Sicilian lemon and sweet geranium. Each spritz blooms beautifully on the skin.

Title: Morning Gardens
Description: Bursting open with the vibrant freshness of cassis, lemon, and grapefruit, this fragrance blooms into a heart of delicate peony, jasmine, and lily. As it settles, a warm, grounding base of vetiver, amber, and musk leaves a lasting impression of effortless elegance and irresistible charm.
